general.temas: La paralización nacional de vuelos y sus consecuencias aparece en los cinco periódicos. También se repiten el escándalo en Nvidia, la pérdida del estatus de eliminación del sarampión, el derrumbe mortal en Brooklyn, la política de asilo, las elecciones en Alaska y la prohibición de impuestos sobre el patrimonio en California. Solo The Wall Street Journal destaca la censura del profesorado de Cornell a su presidente por su respuesta ante denuncias de agresión sexual.
general.motivo_crispacion: La tensión procede de la competencia electoral entre republicanos y demócratas, las críticas a la redistribución de distritos y los insultos a un dirigente demócrata. La política de asilo de Trump llegará al Tribunal Supremo, mientras que el caso Nvidia incluye sospechas de espionaje y desacuerdos entre asesores económicos. También aparecen denuncias de acoso sexual e investigaciones sobre actuaciones oficiales. La cobertura de los vuelos, la salud pública y el tiempo aporta información práctica, aunque algunos de estos asuntos reflejan problemas graves.

noticias.titulo: What to Know About Friday’s Nationwide Ground Stop
noticias.entradilla: The air traffic control system’s overloaded, antiquated telecommunications equipment sustained its latest widespread failure, prompting a call for more money to fuel faster upgrades.

noticias.titulo: Flight Canceled During the FAA Ground Stop? Here’s What to Do.
noticias.entradilla: Travelers are entitled to refunds if their flights are canceled, regardless of the reason, but airlines won’t guarantee other amenities, such as a hotel room or meal vouchers.

noticias.titulo: Nvidia Scandal Prompts Questions of What It Means to Be a Spy
noticias.entradilla: U.S. intelligence agencies believe a woman who had an affair with Jensen Huang was a Chinese asset. But there is much more that they are still assessing about her role.

noticias.titulo: Why Jensen Huang Was Essential to Nvidia’s Rise
noticias.entradilla: Jensen Huang was the driving force at Nvidia, with 60 direct reports and no clear succession plan. Tripp Mickle, one of our technology reporters, examines Mr. Huang’s central role in the company and the artificial intelligence industry.

noticias.titulo: Wall Street Loses a Powerful Dealmaker After Nvidia’s CEO Is Ousted
noticias.entradilla: The ousted Nvidia chief executive was the consummate dealmaker leading the trillion-dollar A.I. build out.

noticias.titulo: Jensen Huang’s Leather Jacket Isn’t Helping Him Right Now
noticias.entradilla: The Nvidia founder’s signature look branded him as a maverick. Does that image read differently now?

noticias.titulo: Alaska Senate Race Between Dan Sullivan and Mary Peltola Still Counting Votes
noticias.entradilla: The race between Senator Dan S. Sullivan and Ms. Peltola, a former congresswoman, is the only Senate contest that hasn’t been called.

noticias.titulo: A Democrat Wins the Alaska Governor’s Race for the First Time Since 1998
noticias.entradilla: Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins made a name for himself as a coalition builder willing to raise alarms about his state’s dire fiscal straits.

noticias.titulo: Lauren Boebert Loses Re-election Bid in Colorado House Race to Eileen Laubacher
noticias.entradilla: Ms. Boebert’s loss to Eileen Laubacher in a conservative House district represents a significant victory for Democrats.

noticias.titulo: Did the Redistricting Wars Backfire on Republicans? In a Word, No.
noticias.entradilla: The G.O.P. was able to avoid more House midterm losses — on top of the advantage it already had from gerrymandering.

noticias.titulo: Developer Avoided Stricter Oversight Before Fatal Building Collapse
noticias.entradilla: By winning approval for a three-story building, then seeking to add more stories, the Brooklyn developer was not subject to the more rigorous oversight required for larger projects.

noticias.titulo: Book Review: ‘Promise Me, America,’ by Joe Biden
noticias.entradilla: The former president’s new memoir trumpets his achievements while justifying his decision to run for a second term and his embrace of Israel’s war in Gaza.

analisis.resumen:
- Un fallo en el control aéreo paralizó vuelos en todo el país; los viajeros afectados tienen derecho a reembolso.
- El escándalo en torno a Nvidia plantea preguntas sobre espionaje y sobre el papel de Jensen Huang, destituido como director ejecutivo.
- Las elecciones dejan victorias demócratas en Alaska y Colorado; sigue el recuento de la contienda al Senado de Alaska. Otro artículo examina las ventajas republicanas en la redistribución de distritos.
- Una investigación señala que un promotor de Brooklyn evitó controles más estrictos antes de un derrumbe mortal.
- Una reseña aborda las memorias de Joe Biden y sus justificaciones sobre su candidatura y la guerra de Israel en Gaza.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina un lenguaje informativo, aunque expresiones como «escándalo» y «guerras de redistribución de distritos» aportan dramatismo a algunos titulares.
analisis.sesgo: La portada presta atención a las victorias demócratas y presenta la redistribución de distritos como una ventaja para los republicanos. También adopta un enfoque crítico hacia los controles de seguridad y examina el escándalo de Nvidia desde varios ángulos.

noticias.titulo: U.S. loses measles-elimination status, erasing a landmark public health achievement
noticias.entradilla: The finding follows a resurgence that began with a major outbreak in West Texas in January 2025 and was followed by sustained outbreaks in Utah, Arizona and other states.

noticias.titulo: FAA lifts ground stop at U.S. airports, leaving travel chaos
noticias.entradilla: Thousands of aircraft were halted for more than four hours because of a “temporary telecommunications outage.” Officials were searching for the cause.

noticias.titulo: For weeks, Brooklyn residents felt the shaking. Then came a deadly collapse.
noticias.entradilla: Eight people were killed, prompting investigations and renewed scrutiny of building-code enforcement.

noticias.titulo: Tanker strike sinks cruise ship in New Orleans, plunging passengers into river
noticias.entradilla: The incident sent 32 people to hospitals, but officials said there appear to be no fatalities.

noticias.titulo: Former death row inmate Richard Glossip pleads guilty to lesser charge
noticias.entradilla: The plea agreement is the latest twist in a decades-long saga that at one point led Oklahoma to review its lethal injection protocols.

noticias.titulo: Supreme Court to review Trump policy blocking asylum seekers at border
noticias.entradilla: The case is the latest immigration issue the justices will weigh in the coming months.

noticias.titulo: Trump’s top economic advisers clash over Lutnick’s handling of Nvidia
noticias.entradilla: The Commerce Department had been investigating if Megaspeed, the company at the heart of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s spy-sex scandal, breached U.S. export restrictions.

noticias.titulo: Woman in truck that crashed into soccer field, killing 2, won’t face charges
noticias.entradilla: The woman was napping in her truck before the vehicle jumped a curb and sped onto the field, officials said.

noticias.titulo: The story behind the viral ad that helped Scott Colom win in Mississippi
noticias.entradilla: Ryan Sayles never had worked on a political campaign before producing the “Pick Another Protein” ad, which ricocheted across the country and internet.

noticias.titulo: Oregon school carefully welcomes students back after classroom shooting
noticias.entradilla: A nonprofit from South Carolina guided the school district in Bend in best practices to deal with trauma after the deaths of three children and a teacher.

noticias.titulo: The Fed chief said AI would tame inflation. His colleagues disagree.
noticias.entradilla: A growing number of Federal Reserve officials say the AI boom may mean higher interest rates for longer. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has been slower to agree, arguing that AI would help tame prices.

noticias.titulo: Eight dead and at least 18 injured after Brooklyn building collapse
noticias.entradilla: A rescue operation continued Thursday as first responders sought anyone trapped beneath the rubble.

analisis.resumen:
- EE. UU. pierde su estatus de eliminación del sarampión tras varios brotes.
- Una avería de telecomunicaciones paraliza durante horas vuelos en aeropuertos estadounidenses.
- Un edificio se derrumba en Brooklyn: mueren ocho personas y se investiga el cumplimiento de las normas de construcción.
- Un choque con un petrolero hunde un crucero en Nueva Orleans; 32 personas son hospitalizadas y no se reportan fallecidos.
- Destacan también casos judiciales y migratorios, disputas económicas sobre Nvidia y la inflación, y la vuelta a clases tras un tiroteo en Oregón.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina un tono informativo, aunque expresiones como «caos en los viajes» y «escándalo de espionaje y sexo» aportan dramatismo y sensacionalismo.
analisis.sesgo: La selección prioriza sucesos trágicos, crisis y conflictos institucionales en Estados Unidos. No se aprecia una orientación política partidista clara en la redacción proporcionada.

noticias.titulo: FAA Lifts Nationwide Groundstop That Upended Flights

noticias.titulo: U.S. Loses Measles-Elimination Status as Historic Resurgence Sickens Thousands
noticias.entradilla: The Pan American Health Organization has revoked the coveted status, people familiar with the matter said—a stunning reversal for a country that for decades has kept the vaccine-preventable disease at bay.

noticias.titulo: A Tanker Lost Control and Hit a River Cruise Ship in New Orleans
noticias.entradilla: The more than 100 people on board were rescued in a ‘miracle on the Mississippi,’ said the Louisiana governor.

noticias.titulo: Congress’s Top Doctor Resigns Amid IG Findings of Lax Drug Handling
noticias.entradilla: Rear Adm. Brian Monahan has been the attending physician to lawmakers and Supreme Court justices since 2009.

noticias.titulo: See What the ‘Super El Niño’ Means for This Year’s Ski Season
noticias.entradilla: Ski areas in the western U.S., coming off one of the driest years on record, could see heavy snows from the weather phenomenon.

noticias.titulo: Cravath Employee Is Charged With Insider Trading Using Confidential Deal Information
noticias.entradilla: Prosecutors said the employee netted $70,000 in profits related to client matters including Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros.

noticias.titulo: The Parents Suing Schools Because Their Kids Got Bad Grades
noticias.entradilla: In Silicon Valley and beyond, families are pressuring teachers or calling lawyers over classroom clashes, from a recess squabble to an essay flagged as “76% AI.”

noticias.titulo: Cold Plunges, Fitness Pop-Ups: The Students Pushing Clean Living on Campus
noticias.entradilla: Gone are the days of instant ramen and all-nighters. Today’s undergrads are maximizing their protein, tracking their sleep and obsessing over hydration.

noticias.titulo: Cornell Faculty Rebuke President Over Response to Sex-Assault Allegations
noticias.entradilla: The no-confidence vote, while largely symbolic, reflects dissatisfaction with the university leadership’s response.

noticias.titulo: The Unlikely College Football Powerhouse Fueled by Texas Gas Money
noticias.entradilla: Tarleton State University might not be a household name. But the school is pouring money into its athletics department to change that.

noticias.titulo: Colleges Struggle to Stop ‘Melt’: Students Who Commit, Then Don’t Show Up
noticias.entradilla: Some students switch after placing deposits at multiple schools; others don’t attend anywhere because of financial challenges.

noticias.titulo: California Voters Pass Ban on Wealth Taxes
noticias.entradilla: The passage of the billionaire-funded ballot measure follows the failure of a high-profile billionaire tax.

analisis.resumen:
- La FAA levantó la suspensión nacional de vuelos, aunque se esperan problemas durante el fin de semana.
- Estados Unidos pierde su estatus de eliminación del sarampión, según personas familiarizadas con la decisión, en medio de un repunte de casos.
- Un petrolero chocó contra un crucero fluvial en Nueva Orleans; las más de 100 personas a bordo fueron rescatadas.
- El médico principal del Congreso dimitió tras hallazgos sobre el manejo laxo de medicamentos. En Cornell, profesores reprocharon a la presidencia su respuesta a denuncias de agresión sexual.
- La portada también aborda educación, salud y deporte, una acusación de uso de información privilegiada y la aprobación en California de una prohibición de los impuestos sobre el patrimonio.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina un tono informativo, aunque expresiones como «histórico resurgimiento», «sorprendente revés» y «milagro en el Misisipi» aportan dramatismo.
analisis.sesgo: La selección da espacio a problemas institucionales, sanitarios y educativos, junto con asuntos de estilo de vida y economía. No se aprecia un sesgo político claro en la redacción presentada.

noticias.titulo: What caused the national ground stop? Here is what we know
noticias.entradilla: For more than four hours, a ground stop of virtually all aircraft in the United States brought unprecedented chaos and delays that are expected to last days. Here is what we know about what went wrong.

noticias.titulo: Nationwide ground stop lifted, but passengers remain stranded at airports
noticias.entradilla: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a ground stop Friday for all flights in the United States, according to an advisory from the agency.

noticias.titulo: Voters pass Proposition 42, barring new taxes on personal assets
noticias.entradilla: The measure had just over 51% votes in favor and nearly 49% opposed, with about 96% of votes counted.

noticias.titulo: O.C. sheriff investigates whether employees alerted ICE before man's arrest
noticias.entradilla: The Orange County Sheriff's Department has launched an internal investigation into whether two employees communicated with ICE agents who detained a man who was leaving the county jail.

noticias.titulo: Thousands of flights affected by FAA ground stop. Here are your rights as a passenger

noticias.titulo: Three men, three agendas: Trump, Putin and Xi will meet in China
noticias.entradilla: The competing agendas could make the summit little more than a spectacle, yet still produce images that harken back to the famous Yalta conference of 1945.

noticias.titulo: LAX, other airports filled with stranded passengers during nationwide ground stop: 'I might spend the rest of my life here'
noticias.entradilla: A four-hour ground stoppage on all flights in the United States on Friday led to chaos for thousands of travelers at airports across California.

noticias.titulo: FBI disrupts crypto theft scheme by North Korean hacking group; billions stolen so far
noticias.entradilla: The FBI said the North Korean hacking group is targeting cryptocurrency executives, Web3 industries, as well as people involved in the development and maintenance of open-source software.

noticias.titulo: Driver in suspected DUI crash that killed North Hollywood vendors charged with murder
noticias.entradilla: Ihor Demianenko, 61, of Valley Village, was charged with murder on Friday for a suspected drunk driving crash that killed three food vendors outside a North Hollywood Metro station.

noticias.titulo: Rain, dangerous surf and snow could hit Southern California. Here's where and when storms are expected
noticias.entradilla: A storm series that arrived Thursday night was expected to be the first of three storms rolling through Southern California.

analisis.resumen:
- La paralización nacional de vuelos dejó miles de pasajeros afectados; se investigan sus causas y se explican los derechos de los viajeros.
- Los votantes aprobaron la Proposición 42, que prohíbe nuevos impuestos sobre bienes personales.
- Se investiga si empleados del sheriff del condado de Orange avisaron a ICE antes de una detención.
- La portada aborda la próxima reunión de Trump, Putin y Xi y la revisión judicial de la prohibición de asilo de Trump.
- Otras noticias tratan sobre delitos, robo de criptomonedas y tormentas previstas en el sur de California.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Predomina el tono informativo, aunque expresiones como «caos sin precedentes» y la cita «podría pasar aquí el resto de mi vida» aportan dramatismo; no se aprecia una apelación al pueblo contra las élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección da especial protagonismo a los efectos de la interrupción aérea sobre los pasajeros y a noticias de California. No se aprecia un sesgo partidista claro en el conjunto de titulares.

analisis.resumen:
- Tiffani Thiessen afirma que necesita un reemplazo de cadera tras un diagnóstico doloroso.
- Un demócrata gana la gobernación de Alaska; otras noticias políticas abordan una investigación por acoso y una protesta contra Hakeem Jeffries.
- Una escuela de Ohio investiga la agresión de un alumno a una alumna en un autobús.
- La portada recoge noticias deportivas sobre UCLA, los Rangers y los problemas de viaje de equipos universitarios.
- El batería de Journey se aparta por motivos de salud y un consultorio aborda una disputa familiar por una herencia.
analisis.motivo_populismo: Expresiones como «rude awakening», «heckler erupts» y «heroic return» aportan dramatismo, aunque no se aprecia una apelación sostenida al pueblo contra las élites.
analisis.sesgo: La selección favorece sucesos, celebridades y conflictos, con un enfoque de interés humano y cierta dramatización. No se aprecia un sesgo político concluyente en el conjunto presentado.
